info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Status API provides access to the current status of fitness memberships for users. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about active, expired, or suspended memberships. Typically used by fitness center administrators and customer service teams, this API enables efficient management and support of members by offering visibility into their membership statuses. It is essential for creating seamless user experiences and operational efficiency within fitness facilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of memberships for a user. It provides detailed information about whether a membership is active, expired, or suspended.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the status of memberships. This should include any necessary identifiers or parameters to specify which membership status is being requested.
